contract: POST /api/podcasts/feed is admin-only: it validates rssFeed as a URL (400), fetches it with the podcast download timeout and an SSRF filter, decodes the bytes (latin1 when the response declares ISO-8859-1) and parses RSS with xml2js; metadata carries title, author, language, itunes:explicit, itunes:type, pubDate, link, the itunes:image href, nested itunes categories, the sanitized description with its plain text and the requested feed URL, and every item with an enclosure (or an audio media:content) becomes an episode with title, subtitle, descriptions, pubDate, itunes episode/season/type/author/duration (plus durationSeconds), explicit, guid, publication timestamp, enclosure and podlove chapters; items without audio, unparsable dates and invalid chapters are tolerated. Any fetch, decode or parse failure answers 404.
evidence: go-backend/testmachine/scenarios/podcast_feed: the six feed scenarios pass against pinned upstream in two consecutive full packet runs
exceptions: force is not applicable: the feed route has no force/override parameter.

The http-to-https redirect retry (podcastUtils.js:404-412) is not exercised: it needs a cross-protocol redirect to a server with a trusted certificate, which a local httptest server cannot provide offline.
The CBC user-agent workaround (podcastUtils.js:360-364) only applies to https://www.cbc.ca and is not exercised offline.

The itunes:new-feed-url value (podcastUtils.js:131-132) is discarded because getPodcastFeed overwrites metadata.feedUrl with the requested URL, so no answer can assert it; the branch stays unexecuted.

invariants.contract: POST /api/podcasts/feed answers 401 without a token and 403 for a non-admin without fetching the feed, and 400 for a missing, non-string or unparsable rssFeed; no rejected request creates rows.

An accepted request answers {podcast: {metadata, episodes}} with the feed title, author, language, explicit, type, pubDate, link, the itunes image, nested itunes categories joined as "Parent:Child", the sanitized description and its plain text, the requested feed URL, and for each playable item the title, subtitle, sanitized content:encoded description and plain description, pubDate, episodeType, season, episode, author, duration string and seconds, explicit, guid, publishedAt (null when unparsable), enclosure (url trimmed, type and length) and chapters with computed ends; an item without audio is skipped, an item whose cover is only in the RSS image element reports no image, ISO-8859-1 bytes decode, attributed text values and bare guids are read, and invalid chapters are dropped.

Two calls for the same unchanged feed answer identical metadata and episode values and create no rows, while a changed remote feed is re-fetched and answers the new title, episode list and publication times.

When the feed is unreachable, answers a non-200 status, is malformed XML, is not RSS, has no channel, has no items or has an empty body, the route answers 404 and creates no row; when the feed exceeds the configured podcast download timeout the route answers 404 within that timeout instead of waiting.
